bio.text: Matt Stone was elected to the Arkansas Senate in November 2022 and sworn in on January 9, 2023; he represents District 2, which includes Calhoun, Dallas, Ouachita and Union counties and part of Grant County.
He has served on the Camden City Council and was appointed to the Arkansas Forestry Division in 2018.
He holds a bachelor's degree in Forestry and Mine Management and Safety and a Doctorate of Theology, is president of Stone Timber Company, Inc., and lives in Camden.
